lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes package-lock.json and uv.lock. Transitive pins move only here, and an aged transitive pin is how a package with a known advisory stays installed.

packageRules.description: Patch, minor, digest and pin updates merge themselves once the branch is green and up to date with main, after the 3-day minimumReleaseAge, as in the sibling repos. Majors and the lock file refresh stay PRs: the refresh takes transitive releases of any age. platformAutomerge arms GitHub auto-merge, which main's ruleset holds until the gate job, and with it every CI job, passes on an up-to-date branch; the merge is a merge commit like every other PR here.
MuQ calls the Conformer encoder directly and needs the v4 hidden states (pyproject.toml), so a transformers major is a port, never a bump.
